<h1 align="center">UI TripleD</h1>

<p align="center">
  <strong>Production-ready UI blocks, components, and full pages available in shadcn/ui and Base UI, powered by Framer Motion, with a Landing Builder, Background Builder, and Grid Generator.</strong>
</p>

<img width="2800" alt="UI TripleD" src="https://iimydr2b8o.ufs.sh/f/Zqn6AViLMoTtmjnFn4EXoBagjvOt2MCq0xnsViJcwbWR4PEp" />

## Features

- **Production-Ready Components** - Carefully crafted UI components built with shadcn/ui & Framer Motion
- **Landing Builder** - Drag-and-drop shadcn/ui blocks to assemble full landing pages in seconds
- **Background Builder** - Shader-powered and animated Aurora backgrounds, fast to tweak and export
- **Grid Generator** - Compose complex Tailwind CSS grid layouts with just a few clicks
- **TypeScript Support** - Full type safety throughout

## Turbo Monorepo

- Managed with Turborepo and pnpm workspaces
- Run tasks via `turbo run <script>` (e.g., `pnpm dev --filter=uitripled-docs` for the docs app)
- Node.js 18+ is required

## Tech Stack

- [Turborepo](https://turbo.build/repo) + pnpm Workspaces
- [Next.js](https://nextjs.org) 16
- [React](https://react.dev) 19
- [TypeScript](https://www.typescriptlang.org)
- [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com)
- [Framer Motion](https://www.framer.com/motion)
- [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com)
- [Base UI](https://base-ui.com)
- [Radix UI](https://www.radix-ui.com)

## Getting Started

Install dependencies:

```bash
pnpm install
```

Run the development server:

```bash
pnpm dev --filter=uitripled-docs
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser.

## Usage

Browse components in the library, preview them, and copy the code directly into your project. Use the visual builder to customize components and see live previews. Try the specialized builders:

- `Landing Builder` for shadcn/ui landing pages
- `Background Builder` for shaders and animated Aurora backgrounds
- `Grid Generator` for Tailwind CSS grids

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome! Please read our [Contributing Guide](./CONTRIBUTING.md) before submitting pull requests.

## License

See [LICENSE](./LICENSE.md) for details.

# about-us-page-shadcnui.md

Source: https://github.com/moumen-soliman/uitripled/blob/master/apps/docs/public/md/about-us-page-shadcnui.md

title: About Us Page
description: Glassmorphism about page showcasing mission, values, and leadership with motion accents.

```tsx
"use client"

import * as React from "react"

import { AboutUsPage } from "@uitripled/react-shadcn/src/components/page/about/about-us-page.tsx"

export function AboutUsPageDemo() {
  return (
    <AboutUsPage />
  )
}
```

## Installation

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @uitripled/about-us-page-shadcnui
```

<ComponentSource name="about-us-page-shadcnui" title="@uitripled/react-shadcn/src/components/page/about/about-us-page.tsx" />

## Usage

```tsx showLineNumbers
import { AboutUsPage } from "@uitripled/react-shadcn/src/components/page/about/about-us-page.tsx"
```

```tsx showLineNumbers
<AboutUsPage />
```

- **Category**: page

# drag-to-confirm-slider.md

Source: https://github.com/moumen-soliman/uitripled/blob/master/apps/docs/public/md/drag-to-confirm-slider.md

title: Drag-to-Confirm Slider
description: Slider that activates action only when fully dragged to end

```tsx
  return (
    <Drag-to-ConfirmSlider />
  )
```

```tsx
  return <GlassmorphismLaunchTimeline />;
}
```

Source: https://github.com/moumen-soliman/uitripled/blob/master/apps/docs/public/md/heart-favorite-shadcnui.md

title: Heart Favorite
description: Animated heart icon for like/favorite actions

```tsx
"use client"

import * as React from "react"

import { HeartFavorite } from "@uitripled/react-shadcn/src/components/micro/icons/heart-favorite.tsx"

export function HeartFavoriteDemo() {
  return (
    <HeartFavorite />
  )
}
```

## Installation

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @uitripled/heart-favorite-shadcnui
```

<ComponentSource name="heart-favorite-shadcnui" title="@uitripled/react-shadcn/src/components/micro/icons/heart-favorite.tsx" />

## Usage

```tsx showLineNumbers
import { HeartFavorite } from "@uitripled/react-shadcn/src/components/micro/icons/heart-favorite.tsx"
```

```tsx showLineNumbers
<HeartFavorite />
```

## Component Details

- **Category**: micro

### Technical Specifications

- `lucide-react`

## Customization

## Accessibility

## Examples

### Basic Example

```tsx
"use client"

import * as React from "react"

import { HeartFavorite } from "@uitripled/react-shadcn/src/components/micro/icons/heart-favorite.tsx"

export function BasicExample() {
  return (
    <HeartFavorite />
  )
```

```tsx
import { NativeTabs } from "@uitripled/react-baseui/src/components/native/native-tabs-baseui.tsx"

export function NativeTabsDemo() {
  return (
    <NativeTabs />
  )
}
```

## Installation

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @uitripled/native-tabs-baseui
```

The `Native Tabs` component uses the following components. Make sure you have them installed in your project.

<ComponentSource name="native-tabs-baseui" title="@uitripled/react-baseui/src/components/native/native-tabs-baseui.tsx" />

## Usage

```tsx showLineNumbers
import { NativeTabs } from "@uitripled/react-baseui/src/components/native/native-tabs-baseui.tsx"
```

```tsx showLineNumbers
<NativeTabs />
```

```tsx
  )
}
```

# our-services-section-shadcnui.md

Source: https://github.com/moumen-soliman/uitripled/blob/master/apps/docs/public/md/our-services-section-shadcnui.md

title: Our Services
description: Services section with service cards, badges, icons, and hover animations

```tsx
"use client"

import * as React from "react"

import { OurServices } from "@uitripled/react-shadcn/src/components/sections/our-services-section.tsx"

export function OurServicesDemo() {
  return (
    <OurServices />
  )
}
```

## Installation

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @uitripled/our-services-section-shadcnui
```

The `Our Services` component uses the following components. Make sure you have them installed in your project.

<ComponentSource name="our-services-section-shadcnui" title="@uitripled/react-shadcn/src/components/sections/our-services-section.tsx" />

## Usage

```tsx showLineNumbers
import { OurServices } from "@uitripled/react-shadcn/src/components/sections/our-services-section.tsx"
```

```tsx showLineNumbers
<OurServices />
```
